name: Summer Days
source:
The Islands Paradise are an archipelago located in the Pacific, near the American continent. Visit this beautiful town recently renovated for tourism. Meet the friendly local population, characterized by their hospitality and affection towards visitors.

In Summer Days, you'll play the role of the young model Cameron, a panther boy who returns to his old home to work. However, during his stay, he reunites with several of his old friends (and meets many new ones) with whom to have fun and have a good time.

[From [url=https://raptorart.itch.io/summer-days]Itch.io[/url]]
